No scripts or hooks are included that would execute arbitrary or external code during or after installation.

While the package uses prebuilt binaries (which inherently limits auditability of the actual executable), this is expected for `-bin` packages in AUR. The transparency of the source URLs and presence of verifiable checksums mitigate supply-chain risks. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or unexpected behavior in the PKGBUILD itself.
